description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed, scenario-based medical exam questions with comprehensive instructions and explanations for exam preparation.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating high-quality, scenario-based MCQs based on difficulty, content, and context.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality and accuracy of generated MCQs, focusing on correctness, clarity, and scenario realism.
